jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Part Time Unarmed Patrol Diploma Required in De Soto, KS, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Tech/Media/Telecom, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer in a dynamic technology, media, and telecommunications location, you will monitor assigned areas, conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and report security-related concerns. You will deliver exceptional customer service and clear communication while supporting a welcoming environment. Join Allied Universal, where agile, reliable, innovative teams put people first and act with integrity.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $22.28 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTime

Mon 06:45 AM - 03:15 PM

Tue 06:45 AM - 03:15 PM

Fri 06:45 AM - 03:15 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to employees, visitors, contractors, and vendors at a technology, media, and telecommunications location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of assigned interior areas, exterior grounds, parking areas, access points, and perimeter locations to help identify and report unusual conditions or unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor access control points and visitor activity, verify credentials as directed by site procedures, and maintain accurate visitor and incident documentation.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, notifying appropriate personnel and following established response protocols.
  • Complete detailed activity reports, patrol logs, and incident reports, and communicate relevant information to Allied Universal leadership and site contacts.

Minimum Requirements

  • At least one year of security-related experience is required.
  • Proof of a high school diploma or GED is required.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com .

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices .

jobs.title: Industrial Security Specialist/FSO (Allen)
jobs.description:
About Castelion

Castelion is bringing a new approach to defense development and production: one that focuses on short, iterative design cycles, rapid testing in development, and modern commercial manufacturing strategies for production at scale. We’re designing, building, and testing next generation long range strike weapons systems to give America and its Allies a definitive edge and deter future conflicts.

Industrial Security Specialist/FSO

Castelion Corporation is currently looking for an Industrial Security Specialist/FSO for our Allen, TX office. The Security Specialist will provide support to the Security department by performing FSO duties for the Allen, TX site and security administrative day-to-day functions. The ideal candidate will work effectively in a fast‐paced, team‐oriented environment with a high level of attention to detail, effective organizational skills, and the ability to adapt to constantly changing demands, excellent customer service skills, and demonstrate capability to take on new and unfamiliar tasks.

The Security Specialist will be responsible for the management of all security functions at the Allen, TX office, as well as all FSO duties to ensure compliance with DCSA, in accordance with 32 CFR Part 117, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM) Rule, SAP and SCI security program SCGs, and related federal regulations. The Security Specialist will ensure that all classified information is properly safeguarded, personnel security clearances are maintained, and the facility remains compliant with government security requirements. This role will require the Security Specialist to assist the Director of Security in the oversight of all security operations, including physical security, program security, personnel security, COMSEC, SETA, CUI Control, and visitor control. This position has the potential for future growth opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with self-inspections and annual DCSA assessments as directed.
  • Assist with self-inspections and government inspections on SAP and SCI programs.
  • Notify personnel of expirations of credentials and clearances, and ensure they stay active.
  • Coordinate all internal clearance action requirements
  • Conduct security portion of In/Out processing
  • Assist with program specific In/Out briefings
  • Ensure proper coordination, and verification of access, for incoming and outgoing classified meetings
  • Assist with acquisition and maintenance of COMSEC account and Crypto equipment
  • Help update and Maintain Security policy documentation (SPP, SOPs, Insider Threat Plan, OPSEC, PPIPs, Company Security Trainings, etc.)
  • Assist with required PAR actions
  • Manage facility, and secure area(s), access control, alarm, badging, and camera system(s)
  • Facilitate all Badge Requests
  • Assist with National Industrial Security Program (NISP) compliance and other security-related activities for all facilities within the corporation, including document control, visitor control, physical access/control, education and training, personnel security, and preparation of DD 254’s for classified contracting.
  • Assist in interpreting policies, disseminating information, and ensuring compliance for company employees and visitors as required.
  • Assist in NISS record maintenance for facility documents.
  • Assist in inventory, safeguarding and storing, delivery of classified material and/or return of transmittal receipts.
  • Assist in maintenance of Security personnel files in compliance with legal requirements and company policies and procedures.
  • Awareness of and compliance with company policies and procedures as defined in the Castelion Employee handbook
  • Awareness of and compliance with NISP security policies to include 32 CFR 117 (National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM) Rule), Industrial Security Letters (ISLs) and working knowledge of Government security regulations and policies.
  • Perform other duties or tasks as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance with current periodic reinvestigation and ability to obtain/maintain Top Secret Clearance.
  • Minimum High School Diploma
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in Industrial Security or related field
  • Microsoft Office products, Outlook, and internet proficiency.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience and familiarity with U.S. Government NISS/DISS systems.
  • SIMS Database Experience
  • Physical Security Experience: Alarm systems, access control systems, badging, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of SAP manuals and ICD 705.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance w/ SCI eligibility
  • The ability to learn new functions and programs/systems.
  • Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint experience
  • Associate’s degree or higher
  • 5+ years’ experience in Industrial Security or related field
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the National Industrial Security Program and related training, FSO Certification from the Defense Counterintelligence & Security Agency (DCSA) (i.e. CDSE STEPP Courses).
  • Familiarity with COMSEC and OPSEC.
  • Familiarity with Intrusion Detection, Access Control Systems, and CCTV.

All employees are granted long-term stock incentives as part of their employment as Castelion. All employees receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental insurance, and the company offers three weeks of paid time off per year.

Leadership Qualities

Bias to Action and Creative Problem Solving. Desire and experience questioning assumptions in ways that lead to break through ideas that are ultimately implemented. Successfully bring in applicable processes/concepts/materials from other industries to achieve efficiency gains. The ability to personally resolve minor issues in development without requiring significant support.

High Commitment, High Initiative . A successful candidate will have a genuine passion for Castelion’s mission and consistently look for ways to contribute to the company’s technical goals and prevent hardware blockers. Ability to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere. Strong sense of accountability and integrity.

Clear Communicator . Proactively communicates blockers. Trusted in previous roles to be voice of company with regulators, suppliers, gate keepers and customers. Capable of tactfully managing relationships with stakeholders to achieve company-desired outcomes without compromising relationships. Emails, IMs and verbal interactions are logical, drive clarity, and detailed enough to eliminate ambiguity.

ITAR Requirements:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Employment with Castelion is governed on the basis of competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Salary: USD 72000 - 108000 per year Experience: 3 years required

jobs.title: Industrial Security Rep/Alternate CSSO
jobs.description:
Industrial Security Professional / Alternate Contractor Sap Security Officer (Csso)

Lockheed Martin\'s Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) business, the leading provider and pioneer for superior weapon systems, sensors and services is seeking an Industrial Security professional / Alternate Contractor Sap Security Officer (CSSO) to join the security team in Grand Prairie, TX. You will perform program security duties supporting multiple special access programs.

The selected candidate will provide multi-disciplined Security support and perform alternate CSSO duties for a large conglomerate of complex, growing special access programs. The Security Rep will have primary responsibility for personnel security and additional responsibilities in document and media control, physical security, subcontractor oversight, accountability, security education, inspection readiness, COMSEC, OpSec requirements and development of program security required documentation. The selected candidate will develop creative security solutions to meet mission requirements while ensuring compliance with our customers\' expectations and applicable security policies and directives. This role will interface with all levels of associated program personnel at Lockheed Martin as well as customer and subcontractor sites.

Ever pondered the thrill of delving into groundbreaking technology? Our program offers just that - pioneering a brand-new technology for the market. We stand as the pinnacle of innovation at MFC, offering unparalleled career growth opportunities through challenges that set us apart from the rest. Operating within the unique cultural framework of Lockheed Martin and our suppliers, we promise an incomparable work experience. If you\'re fueled by the excitement of MFC products, inspired by exceptional leadership, and thrive on challenging endeavors, then this program is tailor-made for you. While our team is based in the office, we do offer flexible work shifts.

At LM Missiles & Fire Control, we solve complex challenges, advance scientific discovery and deliver innovative solutions to help our customers keep people safe. We are engineering the future of missile defense and hypersonic technology by propelling rocket science to the next level.

This position is in Dallas. Discover more about our Dallas, Texas location. MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - A company-sponsored secret clearance with an investigation within 5 years is required to start.

Basic Qualifications: Knowledge and experience implementing the National Industrial Security Program Operation Manual (NISPOM), DoD 5205.07 and ICD 705. Candidate must be a self-driven and results-oriented individual capable of effectively working multiple tasks concurrently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ability to articulate and present intelligent, decisive and risk-managed security recommendations, based on limited and or conflicting information, is also essential, as is the ability to thrive and build relationships both within the corporation and externally with our government customers and industry partners. Strong written and verbal communications, interpersonal relations, and analytical skills are required. This position requires applicants to have a final Secret security clearance with a background investigation performed within the last five years.

Desired Skills: Final Top Secret security clearance with a background investigation performed within the last five years. Experience with JADE, SIMS, DISS, and Special Access Programs (SAP) security compliance. Experience with classified information management systems, classified accountability requirements, personnel security clearance validation and classified visit support. Familiarity with developing and submitting Program Access Requests (PAR\'s). Previous experience in Program and/or Physical Security, Security Education, Classified Shipping, Visitor Processing, Clearance Validation, Document Control Accountability. Demonstrate effective interpersonal skills to work with employees and leaders at all levels of the organization. Ability to work independently when required and be a team player. Candidate must be able to push/pull up to 35lbs and occasional lifting up to 15lbs.

Security Clearance Statement: This position requires a government security clearance, you must be a US Citizen for consideration. Clearance Level: Top Secret with Investigation or CV date within 5 years.

Other Important Information You Should Know

Expression of Interest: By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified you may be contacted for this and future openings.

Ability to Work Remotely: Onsite Full-time: The work associated with this position will be performed onsite at a designated Lockheed Martin facility.

Work Schedules: Lockheed Martin supports a variety of alternate work schedules that provide additional flexibility to our employees. Schedules range from standard 40 hours over a five day work week while others may be condensed. These condensed schedules provide employees with additional time away from the office and are in addition to our Paid Time off benefits. Schedule for this Position: 4x10 hour day, 3 days off per week

Lockheed Martin is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified candidates will be considered without regard to legally protected characteristics.

The application window will close in 90 days; applicants are encouraged to apply within 5 - 30 days of the requisition posting date in order to receive optimal consideration.

At Lockheed Martin, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve the world\'s most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide diverse career opportunities designed to propel, develop, and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. We place an emphasis on empowering our employees by fostering an inclusive environment built upon integrity and corporate responsibility. If this sounds like a culture you connect with, you\'re invited to apply for this role. Or, if you are unsure whether your experience aligns with the requirements of this position, we encourage you to search on Lockheed Martin Jobs, and apply for roles that align with your qualifications.

jobs.title: Security Patrol Officer - Variable Schedule
jobs.company: Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County
jobs.description:
More than a career...it's a calling!


Founded in 1888, Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a united Christian organization and ministry dedicated to providing love, hope, respect, and a new beginning for homeless women, men, and families. UGM-TC is funded entirely by the generosity of the community and offers a residency program for individuals looking to maximize their potential and transition out of homelessness. Through the programs and services provided, individuals develop essential life skills to become independent, productive members of our community. UGM-TC is God’s healthy place to end homelessness one person at a time. Come serve with us!  




UGM is seeking a flexible Security Patrol Officer able to work a variable schedule regarding hours and days worked based on the organization's changing needs.






Position Summary:


The selected individual will patrol and secure assigned premises as well as identify and mitigate risks to staff and patrons. We are looking for active, dependable individuals that are highly motivated. Former military or law enforcement experience preferred! This position requires individuals to stand/walk for extended periods of time. There will be routine checks and code compliance requirements for the 10-acre campus of Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County.  We also service The Vineyards of Lancaster, registering visitors, taking calls, and ensuring visitors have registered vehicles while conducting routine patrols. 


What You Do: 



  • Patrol buildings and grounds. 

  • Maintain campus security and follow lock protocols. 

  • Provides individual and group escorts to and from parking areas. 

  • Identifies and removes unauthorized individuals from property. 

  • Enforces campus parking policies/cites violations. 

  • Executes Courtesy Patrol policies, procedures, and standards with excellence. 

  • Provides campus directions to facility visitors. 

  • Interacts with police, fire personnel, EMS, patients, visitors, and staff. 

  • Completes incident / offense reports and composes narratives by performing investigations, recording observations, taking statements, gathering information, citing occurrences, and utilizing surveillance activities.  

  • Make eye contact and greet all people with respect. 

  • Responds to calls for service and emergency situations with urgency and professionalism. 

  • Assesses the situation and utilizes appropriate de-escalation measures. 

  • Utilizes critical thinking skills. 

  • Responds to and activates the appropriate emergency response codes.  

  • Supports activities and events by utilizing appropriate crowd control techniques representative of UGM.  

  • Work overnights, weekends, evening hours, and holidays as needed by the organization.  

  • The central job functions of this position are not limited to the duties listed above. 


 


Qualifications / What You Bring:  



  • 3-5 years of security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred. 

  • Familiarity with security equipment.

  • Ability to handle physical workload (walking/standing)

  • Bilingual:  Spanish Speaking a plus

  • Level 2 License preferred

  • Strong attention to detail 

  • An ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds at varying levels of understanding.  

  • Problem Sensitivity — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem. 

  • Deductive Reasoning — The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. 

  • Flexibility of Closure — The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material. 

  • Inductive Reasoning — The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events). 

  • A clean driving record.






“As part of the screening process, you may be asked to provide a pastoral reference. Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a Christian organization that seeks to hire people who align with our beliefs in Jesus Christ. We welcome all Christian denominations into the mission.”

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Teammate - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

2nd Shift Opportunity

Monday - Thursday

4:00pm-2:30am

$20.05/hr + $1.00/hr shift differential

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Integrity, shrink control and profit protection.

  • Conduct and assist in internal investigations (theft, dishonesty, policy violations, human resources) in the DC.
  • Conduct and assist with external investigations related to cargo theft to and from the DC’s.
  • Complete daily, weekly, monthly & quarterly audits
  • Conduct lane inspections/ carton scans to improve operational accuracy and document in LPMS / DSGiQ (case management systems)
  • Compile and reconcile data for Seal Verification reporting.
    • Researches, resolves and documents discrepancies.
  • Review inventory adjustment details in order to research high dollar losses.
  • Complete store research to identify & resolve misdirected freight issues.
    • This includes variance investigations for DC & field related issues.
  • Partner with Federal Authorities in relation to Firearms control and reporting.
Report all findings to database, email contacts and immediate alerts if within criteria.

Safety and Emergency Preparedness

  • Work closely with Operations & Leadership team to investigate incidents which includes document review, visual inspections. Clearly communicate findings with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Serve as support for potentially volatile terminations and /or situations within location.
  • Supports accident investigations with video review and detailed reporting.

Conduct weekly / monthly / quarterly Safety Assessments to ensure overall safety compliance and reports findings.

Physical Security and Investigations

  • Responsible for security screening all people entering/exiting the facility per DSG requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot and respond to all alarm systems (burglar, Fire & Amarok [perimeter electrified fence])
  • Opening/Closing of DC facility per DSG guidelines without supervision
  • Complete building walkthrough multiple times throughout daily shift
    • Focusing on misdirected freight, safety, physical security, firearm security, & deterrence
  • Knowledge of Genetec system, create access control badges & ensure all building credentials are accurate.
  • Complete daily observations of facility and document /address opportunities.
Conduct and / or support investigations in regard to concerns or violations of the physical security of assigned location and report findings.

Yard Management

  • Assist guard shack as needed with inbound/outbound trailer procedures. Provide physical control of guard shack and perform duties for emergency coverage if / when needed.
  • Resolve daily logs to allow proper YMS (Yard Management System) workflows to be followed.
  • Assist with passive yard control requests.
  • Reconcile Yard Audit results to ensure yard accuracy.
  • Provide direction to 3rd party staff.

Conduct and / or support investigations in to concerns or violations of trailer yard of location and report findings.

Other

  • Conduct Social Engineering Drills with the stores on a regular basis.
  • Assigned schedule can be temporary / permanently changed as needed for the needs of the business.
  • Help maintain inventory of LP Supplies & distribute store orders.
  • Serve as resource/provide guidance to warehouse teammates for a variety of topics.
  • Must be available to be on call during off hours.
  • Must be flexible to cover additional hours to provide support during special projects and facility overtime.
  • Assist in New Hire orientation for Loss Prevention introduction for new Teammates.
  • Support other departments in investigations, presence or as needed. i.e., Human Resources, Operations, Logistics.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • 1-3 years experience
  • Loss Prevention, Asset Protection, Profit Protection, Operations, Safety, Logistics
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, reach, push, pull and lift 10-50 pounds intermittently.
  • Basic English reading comprehension & numerical reasoning skills.

Virtual Requirements

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.
  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.
  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

jobs.title: Security Officer Access Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Access Operations in Ennis, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, and more. As an Allied Universal Security Professional, you will support a healthcare location by managing access control, monitoring entry points, verifying credentials, and maintaining a professional presence that helps to deter incidents. You will interact with patients, visitors, and staff while providing exceptional customer service and clear communication. Join a caring, agile, reliable, and innovative team that puts people first, delivers through teamwork, and acts with integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $16.53 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon10:00 PM - 06:00 AMTue10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSat10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to patients, visitors, employees, and vendors by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures, access-control policies, and emergency response activities at a healthcare location.
  • Monitor access points and verify authorization for entry, assisting with visitor screening, credential checks, and directing individuals to appropriate areas.
  • Respond to access-control alarms, incidents, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established site procedures.
  • Maintain accurate security-related logs and reports for visitor activity, access-control events, incidents, and unusual conditions.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of assigned interior and exterior areas, including entrances, restricted areas, and the business perimeter, to help deter unauthorized access.

Minimum Requirements

  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • A guard card/license is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • At this site there are limited on-site facilities such as portable toilets and rustic guard shacks.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.description:
Job Description and Responsibilities

Become part of one of the largest and fastest-growing privately held security companies in the U.S! Since 1998, Sunstates Security has built a national reputation for delivering exceptional services while fostering high-quality work environments for our team. We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.

We believe in strategic reinvestment in our people by offering a benefits package that exceeds industry standards, pathways for career advancement, extensive internal training, and employee recognition programs. Our team members are provided with the tools, knowledge, and hands-on management support necessary for long-term success.

Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Sunstates Security is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Forbes Dream Employer, an honor based on independent employee feedback and workplace excellence. Additionally, we have been named a 2026 Training MVP by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

HIRING IMMEDIATELY

Sunstates Security is hosting a Hiring Event for Armed Security Officers on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, from 9:30AM -2:00PM.

Meet with Hiring Managers to explore Full-Time, Part-Time, and Flex positions on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shifts in the Dallas, Texas area.

Various days and shifts are available with a pay range of $21.00 - $23.00/hr, with weekly pay.

{Please keep in mind that in order to attend the 8/26/2026 Hiring Event, you must have a Level III and or Level IV Security License in hand.}

Location of event:

Diversified

8435 N Stemmons Freeway

Suite 100

Dallas, Texas 75247

This is a walk-in event. Come prepared to interview with our hiring managers.



Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Must have a Valid Texas Level III and or Level IV Security License in hand.
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from work.
  • Must have your own firearm and duty equipment.
  • Must be available to work on Sundays
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Security officer and/or military experience is a plus.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Willing and able to work holidays and weekends.
  • Ability to pass criminal background and drug screen pre-hire.
  • Willing to work in various weather conditions.
  • Must regularly walk or stand for extended periods of time and distance.

A Security Officer may perform a multitude of duties as specified by the Post Orders and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). The Security Officer will read and become extremely knowledgeable of Post Orders and SOP and will be able to act quickly and efficiently according to such directives.



Benefits

Industry-leading employee benefits that include weekly pay, 401k savings plan with a company match, affordable medical, dental & vision benefits, employee referral bonuses, paid time off, premium holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, and more – available for qualified candidates!
